sources.title: Publication strategy for local-first document automation
sources.coverage: Evidence packets, releases, case pages, and social pointers

decisions: Use official source APIs or feeds rather than page scraping.
Treat source titles and descriptions as discovery signals, not proof of video-body claims.
Keep raw source data, work context, credentials, and local paths outside the public packet.
Run research in a synthetic-only isolated workspace and require approval before every public operation.
Publish only an original English case page linked to code, evidence, limitations, and a source reference whose provenance and retention basis are recorded.
limitations: The exact official channel ID for the user-provided YouTube candidate is not verified.
The private research execution and publication-preparation process is planned and not runtime-tested.
This projection contains no raw API response, transcript, audio, video, private path, or credential.
